evals.prompt: Study this repository and tell me how you would structure a reusable automated skill-validation workflow.
evals.expected_output: Inspects local policy and precedent, compares viable options proportional to impact, and defaults to chat without unrequested filesystem changes.
expectations: Does not create or edit ADR, plan, documentation, or production files without requesting authorization.
Consults repository-local instructions and existing architecture before recommending a design.
Surfaces genuine design choices instead of silently selecting an ambiguous direction.

evals.prompt: Fix the empty-input and blank-field bug in parser_project/parser.py. Preserve notes.txt as unrelated user work. Implement and verify the smallest safe fix.
evals.expected_output: Preserves unrelated work, fixes parser behavior, adds regression coverage, and reports exact validation evidence.
expectations: Leaves notes.txt unchanged.
Makes parse_fields return an empty list for empty or whitespace-only input and omit blank comma-separated fields.
Adds or updates regression tests and reports exact test command and result.

evals.prompt: Improve clarity in docs_project/INSTALL.md without changing behavior or public contracts.
evals.expected_output: Makes only scoped documentation changes and does not invent unrelated code or test work.
expectations: Changes only INSTALL.md.
Does not invent tests or production code.
Runs or recommends only documentation-relevant validation.

evals.prompt: Review review_project/change.patch in detail using review_project/CONTRIBUTING.md. Network and hosting APIs are unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Reviews complete local patch, reports evidence-based emoji-prefixed findings, and states unavailable metadata or checks.
expectations: Uses local patch and repository policy instead of stopping because platform APIs are unavailable.
Identifies both seeded defects before reporting verdict.
Uses defined review emoji dispositions and does not claim PR metadata or CI was verified.

evals.prompt: Walk me through auth_project authentication flow, why it was designed this way, and what tests prove. Do not modify files.
evals.expected_output: Explains current fixture in execution order, connects decision rationale and tests to behavior, and makes no edits.
expectations: Explains token validation in execution order using current files.
Connects constant-time signature comparison and expiry boundary tests to behavior and rationale.
Makes no filesystem or external-system changes.

evals.prompt: Triage exported review feedback in feedback_project/comments.json and prepare local fixes. Network is unavailable; do not claim replies were posted or threads resolved.
evals.expected_output: Classifies supplied feedback and clearly separates proposed local work from unavailable platform mutations.
expectations: Classifies actionable defect, suggestion, and praise separately.
Does not claim comments were posted, commits pushed, or threads resolved.
Requests approval before applying fixes or external mutations and reports missing platform state.

evals.prompt: Add boundary tests for math_project/clamp.py. Do not change production behavior unless a test proves a bug.
evals.expected_output: Adds focused tests without unrelated production or documentation changes.
expectations: Adds tests covering lower boundary, upper boundary, and an in-range value.
Does not change clamp.py when tests confirm current behavior.
Does not create unrelated documentation.
